title: Quickstart new Libre sensor with NFC reading and blucon
body:
I usually start a new libre sensor with the Libre app 2 hours before the current one stops working. This way the new sensor can be used right away in xDrip using the NFC scan feature, because enough values are available. My normal data source is blucon.

I installed the latest nightly (190519) today and had to start a new sensor. Now my method is not working anymore, only the blucon readings are accepted. Is this behavior new and intended or was it a bug?

comments.body:
@nsghub If you look at the Event Log from the top right menu on main xDrip home screen does it have anything in it about rejecting values due to sensor serial number changes?

Did you issue the Stop/Start menu items for the sensor within xDrip when actually wishing to start using the new sensor?

Yes, I stopped and startet the sensors via the menu items.

I will upload the screenshots from the log later.
@nsghub Is this still relevant or did you switch to L2? If not relevant anymore, please close this issue.

It's not relevant for me anymore. I've switched to G6 ;)
